name: Yield/portion/cost/pricing model
authority: Owner-directed bounded implementation of the provisional FOOD-003D candidate; compatible with FOOD-003 economics and FOOD-002/003A/B/C separation.

contract.money: FOOD-local nonnegative safe-integer minorUnits and explicit three-uppercase-letter ISO-style currency. No conversion or currency registry claim; source/candidate zero is valid. Existing money structures found in commerce/insurance are domain-specific and not imported.
contract.ingredient: Reuse FOOD-003C exact owner kind/id/version/ingredientIndex and versioned opaque source references via two additive validator exports. Profile validates against exact recipe draft or component context; retains purchasedGrams and integer purchase money. Cost-per-gram derived only.
contract.arithmetic: Positive gram numbers interpreted by their canonical JavaScript decimal string including exponents, converted to exact decimal rational with BigInt arithmetic. Reduced numerator/denominator stored as JSON-safe canonical decimal strings. Denominator positive; normalized numerator/denominator at most 2048 digits. Explicitly reject excessive precision. No binary floating-point money arithmetic, intermediate rounding or general units/math library.
contract.cost: Currency explicitly supplied to derivation. Known zero differs from missing required profile. Missing profiles or components give unknown total/per100 and incomplete status; known input profiles remain in provenance. Reject wrong/duplicate/unused profiles and mixed currencies. Component contribution=inputGrams*purchaseMinorUnits/purchasedGrams. Recipe component contribution=componentTotal/componentYield*inputGrams. Per100=total/yield*100. Components one level only.
contract.provenance: Retain detached exact formulation, validated acquisition profiles/source revisions and exact component cost projections. Recipe projection retains draft context for validating ingredient indices. Revalidate incoming derived profiles by recomputing from retained exact inputs and comparing canonical summaries; no source trust/existence claim.
contract.portion: Exact recipe id/version and positive targetGrams validated against FOOD-003B formulation context. No portion/SKU/serving-offer identity. Yield projection uses exact decimal rationals: floor(yield/target), exact fractional count and exact rational remainderGrams. Full count must fit safe integer. Cost=recipeTotal/yield*target; unknown remains unknown.
contract.scenario: Planning-only exact portion and revalidated recipe cost retained. Candidate money explicit and compatible. costBasis=ingredient-formulation-cost-only. Gross profit may be negative. Food-cost percentage=cost/price*100; margin=(price-cost)/price*100, exact rational analysis values. Zero price produces unavailable percentages with zero-price reason; unknown cost gives cost-incomplete reason. No net-profit claim or omitted-cost inclusion.
contract.stability: Later evidence, component/recipe version, nutrition or capture does not update prior frozen projections/scenarios. FOOD-003B yield remains authoritative. Missing cost cannot become zero.
contract.limits: At most 128 acquisition/component profiles; existing formulation limits apply. Pure synchronous constructors; recursive freeze and detached validation.
contract.separation: Capture, formulation/version, nutrition, acquisition/component/recipe cost, portion, scenario, product, SKU, serving offer, published price and order remain distinct.

operations: Synthetic fixtures only. No real recipe/prices/portions, external operations, staging, commit or push.
